segments.text: At the Dunphy house, Phil and Claire find a burn mark on the sofa. They assume that one of the children has been smoking, but Haley, Alex, and Luke all deny it. Phil decides to cancel Christmas until somebody tells the truth.

segments.text: He removes the tree, the decorations, and the presents, expecting the guilty child to confess. Nobody does. Alex finally takes the blame even though she is innocent because she does not want the whole family to lose Christmas.

segments.text: Their attempt to help becomes awkward because they keep making assumptions about him and his life.

segments.text: Overall, the episode shows how quickly people can become controlling during the holidays. Everyone wants the “right” kind of Christmas, but the family only enjoys it after they admit their mistakes and make room for one another’s traditions.
